title: The Pirate Hoard
summary: The harbourmaster says the black ship's surviving crew are picking over shipwrecks for its lost cargo. Find a shipwreck and stop them.

dialogue.intro: What's left of the crew. They're looting every wreck on the coast for the Kraken's cargo.
dialogue.reward: Fewer looters on the water. Good.
offer: What's left of the crew. They're looting every wreck on the coast for the Kraken's cargo.
Any wreck along the shore. Follow the gulls.

goals.say: Fresh footprints in the sand, and a crate already pried open.
The last looter's pockets hold a gold coin stamped with an eye.
